com.github.gbenroscience:parser-ng-gpu-simd 3.0.5 发布, Hardware-accelerated, scalable(scalability of SIMD tested on Linux-(Centos tested)) SIMD vector and GPU calculation pipelines for ParserNG.
        Fastest Java math evaluator in the world period
        Rich and Performant, Cross Platform Java Library(100% Java).No native dependencies.(e.g. JNI) 
        Version 3.0.5 features the addition of parser-ng-arrow, our integration with Apache Arrow, and other prior features like GPU bulk evaluation for OpenCL(tested) and CUDA. It also features the SIMDEnginvEvaluator and SIMDCommandTurboEvaluator, both
        of which benefit from CPU Pinning to minimize cache thrashing and other stories. This leads to highly efficient worker-count to output velocity conversion. 
        For library support, customizations or donations, reach me at gbenroscience@gmail.com|+2348165779034

items.title:
com.github.gbenroscience:parser-ng 3.0.5 发布, Rich and Performant, Cross Platform Java Library(100% Java).No native dependencies. 
        ParserNG is the height of interpreted Math parsing in Java. It is the fastest of all interpreted Java math parsers.
        Features the introduction of native logic processing within the engine: the if(cond, trueVal, falseVal) method, the AND operator and the OR operator;
        automatic differentiation to the nth-order, a brand new symbolic differentiation engine, 
        a symbolic integration backed with a resilient numerical integration engine.
        Differential Equations solver is the shiny new feature of ParserNG. It is a highly optimized and robust solver that can handle 
        stiff and non-stiff ODEs, as well as systems of ODEs. 120 tests have been added to the differential equations solver engine
        For library support, customizations or donations, reach me at gbenroscience@gmail.com|+2348165779034
